title: Sion
summary: Elevated. (1.) Denotes Mount Hermon in Deut. 4:48; called Sirion by the Sidonians, and by the Amorites Shenir (Deut. 3:9). (See [594]HERMON.)

inlines.v: Elevated. (1.) Denotes Mount Hermon in Deut. 4:48; called Sirion by the Sidonians, and by the Amorites Shenir (Deut. 3:9). (See [594]HERMON.)
(2.) The Greek form of Zion (q.v.) in Matt. 21:5; John 12:15.
